description: Source code for bug localization using the UniXcoder model, including text encoding and file ranking based on embeddings.

classes.name: BugLocalization
classes.description: Class for encoding texts and ranking files based on bug report similarity using UniXcoder embeddings.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the BugLocalization class, sets up device and model.

methods.name: encode_text
methods.description: Encodes long text by splitting into chunks, tokenizing, and generating normalized embeddings.

methods.name: rank_files
methods.description: Ranks files based on maximum cosine similarity between query and file embeddings.
